summary: Iter 281 — Frontend e2e validation of new P2 'SB Access Plus' subscription on SB Drive Access. ALL 5 UI scenarios PASS. (T1) PMR user paul.vendeur@example.com logs in via /login → 'Email & mot de passe' → /login/email → lands on /home → navigate to /access; the landing card 'SB Access Plus' (access-plus-entry) with the open button (access-open-plus-btn) is visible. Clicking opens the bottom-sheet (plus-sheet) which shows the plans panel (plus-plans-panel) with both plus-plan-access_plus_monthly (9.99€/mois) and plus-plan-access_plus_yearly (99.99€/an); each lists 4-5 avantages (-15%/-20% adapted trips, attribution prioritaire, +10/+15 min assistance, priorité SOS, 2 mois offerts for yearly). (T2) Clicking plus-subscribe-access_plus_monthly produces toast 'Access Plus activé ✨' and the panel switches to plus-active-panel showing 'ABONNEMENT ACTIF · Access Plus Mensuel · Valable jusqu'au 11/07/2026' + 4 avantages + plus-cancel-btn. (T3) Closing the sheet (overlay click) and reopening (access-open-plus-btn) preserves the active state. Landing card now displays the ACTIF badge (plus-active-badge) next to 'SB Access Plus'. (T4) In the active panel, clicking plus-cancel-btn (with dialog auto-accepted) triggers toast 'Abonnement résilié' and the panel reverts to plus-plans-panel. (T5) Admin admin@superapp.com → /admin/access → tab '👑 Access Plus' (admin-access-tab-plus) shows plus-revenue block with plus-active-subs=0 (after cancellation), revenu total=9.99€, souscriptions=1, plus-plan-row-access_plus_monthly + plus-plan-row-access_plus_yearly editable. Changed plus-price-access_plus_monthly from 9.99 → 12.99, clicked plus-save-access_plus_monthly, toast 'Plan mis à jour' confirmed; reload + reopen Plus tab shows price persisted as 12.99. Restored to 9.99 (and re-verified persistence) for cleanliness as suggested by problem-statement note.
critical_code_review_comments: SbAccessPage.js line 421-430: the access-plus-entry card cleanly conditionally renders the plus-active-badge based on `plusSub` state — verified the badge appears on landing after subscribe and disappears after cancel. Good.
SbAccessPage.js line 919-944: bottom-sheet uses overlay click + stopPropagation pattern for close; works reliably on mobile viewport 430px.

AdminAccess.js PlusAdmin (line 565+) uses an edits[p.id] dirty-tracking pattern that only shows the 'Enregistrer' button once a field is changed — good UX preventing accidental saves, but no inline validation: a price of 0 or negative is currently saveable. Consider client-side min=0.01 validation.

Toast on save returns 'Plan mis à jour' (matches success criteria), and persistence after page reload confirmed twice (12.99 → reload → 12.99, then 9.99 → reload → 9.99). Backend PUT /api/access/admin/plus/plans/{id} round-trip is solid.

Revenue panel shows revenu total=9.99€ and souscriptions=1 even after cancellation (active_subscribers correctly drops to 0). Indicates revenue/subscription counters are cumulative (lifetime) while active_subscribers is current — matches expected SaaS-style reporting; clarify with the product whether 'Souscriptions' should label as 'Total souscriptions (vie)' to avoid confusion since the test left exactly 1 cancelled record.

context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 'SB Access Plus' fully working end-to-end. Login flow same as iter 280: /login → 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → 'Email & mot de passe' → /login/email → fill + submit (lands on /home, then navigate to /access or /admin/access). After this test paul has 0 active subs and wallet ~90.01€; revenue panel shows 1 historical subscription + 9.99€ cumulative.
